<!--
Measured, not read: in the .pdf a short table in the text flow is not broken
over two pages. A longtable may break after any row, and the four-row table
in example.qmd was broken after its first: its title, head and first row at
the foot of one page, the rest under a repeated head on the next. A table of
fifteen rows or fewer that pandoc writes is set as one tabular, kept with its
title, caption and the start of its note, and moves to the next page whole
when it does not fit.

Each table starts a page of its own after a counted run of lines. After 21,
the title, head and first row of a table fit and the rest do not; the short
table there goes over whole. After 12 it fits and stays. The long table after
21 lines is still a longtable: it begins where it stands and breaks.
-->
